ambient_events: A wall of dark monitors waits, every one of them a window into someone's living room.
The ON AIR lamp above the booth is dark. For now.
Somewhere a cooling fan spins up, spins down, and the room is silent again.
description: The broadcast complex — a compact television studio and, behind armored glass, the Emergency Broadcast Room. A production console faces a bank of monitors that mirror every tuned screen in the city. This is the one deck aboard that reaches outward: from here the Echelon can seize every set in Architect and speak with a single voice. An ON AIR lamp hangs dark above the booth. The engineering corridor lies to the NORTH.
name: Echelon — Broadcast Complex
